name: Whelping Downs
summary: The Whelping Downs is a rugged, ash-choked hollow situated just south of Blackrock Mountain in the Burning Steppes. Here, the orcs of the Dark Horde tend and breed clutches of black dragonflight whelps. Captive young from other flights are also corralled in this nursery before being sent into the mountain for dark experimentation.

sections.title: A Draconic Nursery
sections.body: Sprawling across the scorched earth south of Blackrock Mountain, the Whelping Downs serves as an open-air hatchery and rearing ground for the black dragonflight. Blackrock clan whelpers vigilantly patrol the crags, feeding and sheltering broods of young black dragons who take wing among the volcanic plumes. The sight underscores the deep and dangerous alliance binding Nefarian's brood to Rend Blackhand's Dark Horde.

sections.title: Stolen Flights
sections.body: Black whelps are not the only denizens of the Downs. The Blackrock orcs also herd captured whelps belonging to the other dragonflights into these stony gullies. Kept under close watch, these helpless captives are held here temporarily until they can be hauled up into the heights of Blackrock Spire, destined for Nefarian's twisted alchemical laboratories and genetic experiments.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Whelping Downs?
faq.answer: It serves as a dragon breeding ground and holding pen run by the Blackrock clan. Black dragonflight whelps are raised and guarded here, while stolen young from other dragonflights are held before being moved into Blackrock Spire.

faq.q: Why are the Blackrock orcs raising dragons?
faq.answer: Rend Blackhand and his Dark Horde are allied with Nefarian, the master of the black dragonflight residing within Blackrock Spire. In exchange for dragonflight support and aerial dominance, the orcs help incubate, tend, and guard Nefarian's growing broods.

faq.q: What happens to the whelps brought into Blackrock Spire?
faq.answer: Captured whelps from other flights are transported into the Spire to serve as fodder for Nefarian's horrific experiments, where he works to combine the blood and essences of all dragonflights into a new, artificial breed.

faq.q: Who guards the young dragons in the Downs?
faq.answer: The area is maintained and guarded by specialized Blackrock Whelpers—orcs trained to feed, handle, and defend the young drakes from intruders and rival scavengers.

angles.text: Seeing orcs subjugated to serving as caretakers and nurserymen for Nefarian's brood is a stark reminder to Thrall's Horde of the corruption and servitude that binds Rend's renegades.

The teeming broods at the foot of Blackrock Mountain represent a looming aerial threat to nearby Redridge and the Kingdom of Stormwind, demanding preemptive culling before they grow into mature drakes.
